summary: Stage 0 resolves the Python interpreter portably so the orchestrator runs under PowerShell 7 on Linux.
prompt: Running `pwsh ./sh/sovereignshield_up.ps1 -AccountId <id> -TenantDomain <domain> -StopAfterStage 0` on Ubuntu fails in Stage 0 with "Required command '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' was not found on PATH", although .venv exists and the offline tests pass when run directly. Make Stage 0 work on both Linux and Windows.
